::: {#def-t-dist}
#### t-distribution

Let $Z$ have the standard Gaussian distribution,
let $V$ have the $\chi^2_k$ distribution (@def-chi-square-dist),
and let $Z$ and $V$ be independent.
The distribution of

$$\frac{Z}{\sqrt{V/k}}$$

is the **t-distribution with $k$ degrees of freedom**
(or Student's t-distribution), written $t_k$.
:::
